# Waymark 0.3.1 preview

- Passive character and pet reading no longer pauses just because NotMeter is open. Waymark uses its own Npcap handles and does not consume NotMeter data or change its settings.
- Verified two independent Npcap processes receiving identical self-owned localhost traffic, isolated filters, and continued capture after one reader closes. Actual simultaneous gameplay with NotMeter still needs a later check.
- Publish a valid visual position before optional feather scanning. Scanner exceptions no longer discard a fresh position; partial feather evidence is cleared after failure.
- Reset player-symbol search caches when foreground visibility, character/session, game process or viewport context changes. Stale and mismatched position results are still rejected.
- Keep Waymark's internal reader/recording lease and the existing research-recording restriction. Raw research captures still require closing NotMeter, A2Tools and AetherTrail.

Verified offline with sampler fault injection and saved map/minimap images. No new game interaction or live capture was performed. Automatic dungeon/stronghold completion, live inventory/resources, mid-session identity recovery and new map-transition coverage remain pending game evidence.
